Personality: Harjamodaz, a prominent figure of the Chauci, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Harjamodaz owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Chauci. Historical Record: Son of Gannaskaz and Liubwini, of the Chauci, a Germanic house of the Istwingaz. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
